title: rbac v2: enforce KMS region pinning and tighten audit logging for residency
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Enforce KMS key region pinning for RBAC v2 policies and expand residency audit logging; no customer-facing API changes, backend policy enforcement and audit hardening.
description: Context: We have observed gaps where user-specified KMS keys could be used cross-region unintentionally when RBAC v2 residency policies are set. This PR enforces region pinning for KMS-backed encryption keys when a resource residency constraint is present and hardens audit logging to surface policy evaluation decisions for compliance reviews. Motivation: close a compliance gap reported in SUP-1345 and to ensure audit trails contain the policy context for KMS operations. Changes: 1) RBAC policy evaluation: add explicit region pinning check in rbac_v2 policy engine so that requests that reference a KMS key must match the resource residency region or be denied with a clear error code (RBAC_KMS_REGION_MISMATCH). 2) KMS integration: validate key metadata (region, account) during key registration and surface warnings for cross-account or cross-region keys in the control plane. 3) Audit logging: emit structured audit events for policy evaluation outcomes (allowed/denied), the matched residency rule, evaluated key metadata, and user-supplied justification (when present). 4) DB migration: add kms_region and kms_account columns to resource_keys and backfill from prior metadata where available; migration includes idempotent re-checks. 5) Tests & CI: unit tests for policy logic, integration tests mocking KMS metadata, and an end-to-end smoke test exercising an RBAC policy with residency constraints. Backwards compatibility: when no residency rule is present we preserve previous behavior; operators can opt into "strict_key_residency" enforcement via a feature flag. Rollout plan: staged deploy - enable audit-only mode for 24-72h in production for two customer-tenants, then flip enforcement with monitoring and automatic rollback on error-rate regressions. Checklist: - [x] Add policy check and unit tests - [x] Add DB migration and backfill - [x] Add structured audit events and observability dashboards - [x] Run security-scan and compliance checks - [x] Document feature flag and rollout notes

diff_snippets:
--- a/redwood/core/rbac_v2/policy_evaluator.py
+++ b/redwood/core/rbac_v2/policy_evaluator.py
@@ -210,6 +210,22 @@
     # existing policy checks
+    # new: enforce kms region pinning when residency rule present
+    if policy.has_residency and request.kms_key:
+        key_meta = kms_registry.get_key_meta(request.kms_key)
+        if key_meta.region != policy.residency_region:
+            return Decision.DENY, 'RBAC_KMS_REGION_MISMATCH'
+

--- a/redwood/observability/audit_sink.py
+++ b/redwood/observability/audit_sink.py
@@ -42,6 +42,14 @@
     # previously we logged free-text; now emit structured payloads
+    event = {
+        'event_type': 'rbac_policy_evaluation',
+        'user': ctx.user_id,
+        'decision': decision.name,
+        'policy_id': policy.id if policy else None,
+        'matched_residency': getattr(policy, 'residency_region', None),
+        'kms_key_meta': key_meta.as_dict() if key_meta else None
+    }
     audit_sink.emit(event)
review_comments: Ben Liu: Can we make the migration backfill idempotent and rate-limited? Backfills in prior migrations caused load spikes.
Asha Patel: Backfill is idempotent and uses batch windows with backpressure; added note in migration script and docs. See added backfill_kms_region.py
Sofia Martinez: We need clearer error messaging for customers when a key is rejected due to region mismatch. Also add a non-blocking warning path under feature flag.
Asha Patel: Added RBAC_KMS_REGION_MISMATCH error code and operator CLI to list mismatched keys. Also implemented audit-only mode via strict_key_residency flag before enforcement.
Evan Chen: Security scan flagged potential information leakage in audit events (full key ARN). Please redact sensitive bits.
Asha Patel: Audit event now includes only key id, region, and account; removed full ARN. Security scan rerun passed.
Ben Liu: Approving after CI green and one minor doc nits fixed.
